processes.meter_deal_extension_or_setup: Logistics asks the deal owner to create, extend or renegotiate a deal ticket so flowing volumes at a meter are covered and allocated.
processes.unaccounted_gas_writeoff_approval: Logistics sends a signed-approval request to write off stray meter volumes to Unaccounted for Gas or supply a deal.
processes.pipeline_pathing_and_pool_correction: Fixing path, interconnect, pool and allocation entries for pipeline deals and chasing the deal owner for status.
processes.deal_price_discrepancy_resolution: Resolving price, volume or Sitara deal-entry mismatches between billing, counterparty and system records, including corrections to protected tickets.
processes.unfinaled_invoice_followup: Distributing lists of unfinaled invoices and chasing groups to research and final them by deadline.
processes.monthly_cost_survey_completion: Completing recurring activity driver or salary surveys for finance by a deadline.
processes.daily_flow_and_nomination_monitoring: Reporting and reviewing daily meter flows, cuts, nominations and volume variances, and deciding on nomination adjustments.
processes.counterparty_volume_confirmation: Confirming monthly volumes, transaction confirmations or settlement figures with counterparties or internal desks.
